accepted_definition: Accepts this actual limited normal-A simulated-account report as a readable, attributable account decision covering all three securities, cash, alternatives, adverse evidence and change conditions. The two precise representation errors below remain errors; this review neither rewrites them nor accepts its wording as proof of formal forecasting. It is not investment accuracy, a complete research dossier, human sign-off or completion of the A-sale/B matrix.

IDs are shortened rather than full direct identifiers, so the mapping below is needed for exact navigation. All 29 saved operations were independently reproduced with Decimal; arithmetic success does not itself validate an unattributed price-date association.

Three submitted suggestions persisted as three watching recommendations. All nine submitted exploratory targets persisted (two down, seven abstain). Each receipt ID matches its stored row. One version-4 current report remains identical across two after-publication and two after-real-process-restart observations; ledger facts are unchanged and no extra model task ran.

The system batch and all nine rows are exploratory. Narrative use of 正式预测 is not an accurate system classification and is rejected as such. Actual directions and abstentions match the report, but formal forecast sample count remains zero and there is no mature accuracy evidence.
